LESSON: PYTHAGOREAN RELATIONSHIP

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements
Topic 3.1: Pythagorean Relationship
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Pythagorean Relationship, part of Measurements in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use Pythagorean relationship in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

● Learning to learn: as the learner applies Pythagorean relationship in real life situations.
